The Senior Windows Systems Administrator will provide technical leadership and hands-on administration of Windows server infrastructure, Exchange services, and enterprise systems supporting fleet customers and the Network Operations Center (NOC). Responsibilities include system configuration, troubleshooting, security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and implementation of Department of Defense (DoD) security requirements. Monitor Exchange server performance, troubleshoot service interruptions, and implement improvements to maintain system availability and functionality. Implement and maintain Global Address List (GAL) synchronization between forests using Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM). Manage Windows Server environments, including installing software, applying security patches and updates, performing system upgrades, and troubleshooting operating system issues. Establish and maintain administrator and service accounts while ensuring appropriate access controls and security configurations. Assist in developing and implementing guidelines and procedures supporting system accreditations and Command Cyber Operational Readiness Inspections (CCORIs). Develop, implement, and maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, and system failover/cutover procedures. Implement and maintain DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) across Windows Server environments. Identify, assess, and remediate security vulnerabilities and technical compliance gaps, ensuring new STIG requirements are implemented within established timelines. Respond to, troubleshoot, resolve, and document customer Windows operating system and email issues through the Navy Enterprise Service Desk (NESD) ticketing system (Helix). Evaluate vendor hardware and software products and provide technical recommendations to support procurement decisions. Maintain accurate technical documentation, configuration records, and operational procedures. Provide written and verbal project updates, technical findings, and status reports to management and leadership. Coordinate with technical teams, government stakeholders, and project leadership to ensure system availability, security, and operational readiness. Active Secret Clearance Minimum of five (5) years of progressive IT experience, including significant Microsoft Windows administration experience within the past three (3) years. Minimum of two (2) years of supervisory experience overseeing complex IT projects. DoD 8570.01-M Information Assurance Technician (IAT) Level II certification or current equivalent certification meeting applicable DoD requirements. CompTIA Security+ or equivalent certification. Demonstrated experience administering and maintaining Microsoft Windows Server environments. Experience troubleshooting enterprise operating systems, email services, and network-related issues. Ability to coordinate multiple technical initiatives and communicate project status to leadership. Assist system owners when required to perform their testing on new and existing systems.
